This matter was called on for hearing today.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SUDHANSHU DHULIA  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AHSANUDDIN AMANULLAH

For Petitioner(s) Ms. Shraddha Deshmukh , AOR  For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Delay condoned.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner.

The respondent nos.1 to 12 are accused in a case bearing FIR No.678/2021 registered by the petitioner against them for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, and 34 of the Indian Penal Code against which they filed a petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure before the High Court for quashing of criminal proceedings arising out of the aforesaid FIR.

By the order impugned, the High Court had allowed the petition 17:45:28 IST Reason:
Tejaswini vs Vishwajeet on 3 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143282731/
1 qua respondent nos.3 to 12 and quash the criminal proceedings by giving well considered reasons.

sentences.text: We see no reason to interfere in the order passed by the High Court, in exercise of our jurisdiction under Article 136 of the Constitution of India.
The present petition is, accordingly, dismissed along with pending application(s), if any.

(NIRMALA NEGI) (RENU BALA GAMBHIR)
